text:
Lina (sales): Prospect 'Europay Bank' asks for EU-only residency POC: BYOK, no US egress, telemetry must remain in EU. Need concise handoff doc today.
Tom (se): Quick: BYOK + HSM required? Also they want audit exportability for 24 months.
Ravi (eng): BYOK supported. Hosted can use eu-west-1 KMS; Dedicated/Private required for customer HSM import. We can enable EU-only control plane for the POC to avoid metadata leaving EU.
Hanna (sre): Subprocessors: compute/storage run in EU (aws eu-central, gcp europe-west). Default monitoring vendor is US-based; we must disable that for EU-only telemetry.
TicketBot: Created ticket #7001 "europay-poc-eu-only" assigned to Ravi. ETA 48h for ops checklist.
Nora (legal): Will need subprocessors export, DPA addendum for 24mo log retention, and proof of deletion workflow.
Tom (se): Drafting 1-pager: routing sample, KMS options, peering checklist, subprocessors link, and ballpark quote.
Lina (sales): Ballpark for 2-week POC + 1mo reserved? Need a number for procurement.
Ravi (eng): Rough: ~$20k for 2-week eval with reserved burst (2x A100 equiv). Dedicated small pool add ~$10k/mo. Final after perf sizing.
Tom (se): Sample routing payload to include: 
```json
{"tenant":"europay-poc","routing":{"mode":"pin","primary":"eu-central-1","failover":["eu-west-1"]},"kms":{"type":"BYOK","region":"eu-west-1","hsm":true}}
```
Hanna (sre): If they want VPC peering, collect CIDR + peering contact. Also confirm they don't want cross-region DB replicas outside EU.
Lina (sales): I'll gather CIDRs and SIG questionnaire and send to Nora.
Nora (legal): Received SIG later today, will flag DPA exceptions.
Tom (se): Uploading handoff + quote to Drive: https://drive.redwood/POC/europay-euonly.
Lina (sales): Thanks team! Will attach doc to RFP. :pray:
